Short title and commencement

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
SOCIETIES
REGISTRATION
(BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
ACT II OF 1997
An Act further to
amend the Societies Registration Act, 1860
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 1997]
No. PAB/LEGIS:V(4)/97, dated
17-11-1997.--The Societies Registration (Balochistan Amendment) Bill, 1997
staving been passed by the Provincial Assembly on 8th November, 1997 , and
assented to by the, Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called The Societies Registration (Balochistan Amendment) Act,
1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new section after section 4, of Act XXI of 1860

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
SOCIETIES
REGISTRATION
(BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
ACT II OF 1997
An Act further to
amend the Societies Registration Act, 1860
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 1997]
No. PAB/LEGIS:V(4)/97, dated
17-11-1997.--The Societies Registration (Balochistan Amendment) Bill, 1997
staving been passed by the Provincial Assembly on 8th November, 1997 , and
assented to by the, Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
2. Insertion of new section after
section 4, of Act XXI of 1860.----In the Societies Registration Act, 1860,
in its application to the Province of Balochistan, hereinafter referred to as
the said Act, after section 4, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:--
"4-A. Audit Report.---Once
in every year on close of financial year and Audit Report by Accountants as
defined in Income Tax Act, shall be provide by the Governing Body duly signed
and approved to the Registrar of Societies It shall be mandatory to keep Books
of account interring therein income from all sources and expenditure incurred
by the Society. The Registrar of Societies may examine the entries in the Book
of account as and when needed".

Insertion of new section after section 5, of Act XXI of 1860

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
SOCIETIES
REGISTRATION
(BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
ACT II OF 1997
An Act further to
amend the Societies Registration Act, 1860
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 1997]
No. PAB/LEGIS:V(4)/97, dated
17-11-1997.--The Societies Registration (Balochistan Amendment) Bill, 1997
staving been passed by the Provincial Assembly on 8th November, 1997 , and
assented to by the, Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
3. Insertion of new section after
section 5, of Act XXI of 1860.--In the said Act, after section 5, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"5-A. Member of Society
shall not avail financial benefit.--All Non Government Organizations and
Societies registered under this Act, shall work to achieve the objectives on
non-commercial basis. Any member of the society shall not avail financial
benefits from movable and immovable property of the Society and any member of a
Society shall not be a paid employee of that Society".

Amendment of section 20, of Act XXI of 1860

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
SOCIETIES
REGISTRATION
(BALOCHISTAN
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
ACT II OF 1997
An Act further to
amend the Societies Registration Act, 1860
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 1997]
No. PAB/LEGIS:V(4)/97, dated
17-11-1997.--The Societies Registration (Balochistan Amendment) Bill, 1997
staving been passed by the Provincial Assembly on 8th November, 1997 , and
assented to by the, Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly.
4. Amendment of section 20, of
Act XXI of 1860.--In the said Act, for section 20, the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"20. To what Societies
Act applies. ---The following Societies may be registered under this Act:--
Charitable Societies, Societies
established for the promotion of Science, Literature or the fine arts, for
instruction, the diffusion of useful knowledge (the diffusion of political
education), the foundation or maintenance of Libraries or reading-rooms for
general use among the members or open to the public, or public museums and
galleries of paintings and other works of art, collections of natural history,
mechanical and philosophical inventions, instruments or designs, Management,
overseeing, monitoring and providing Supervisory cover to, local institutions such
as Primary Schools, Middle Schools, High Schools, Dispensaries, Basic Health
Units and Rural Health Centers and other Health Institution, Population Welfare
facilities, Water Supply and Sanitation facilities. "
